about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm Islam Elsayed, a systems architect and senior full-stack engineer based in Alexandria, Egypt, and the founder of ShiftCodes. I build production software for organisations across Egypt and the Middle East, including enterprise ERP, government analytics, banking and insurance, learning platforms and multi-tenant SaaS.

My work starts with the real operation: how people approve, inspect, sell, ship and report. I model that operation before I write code. The result is software with clear permissions, auditable workflows and data that stays correct under retries, failures and growth.

I work mainly in PHP (Laravel, Filament, Yii2) and Python (FastAPI, Django), with React, Next.js and Livewire on the front end, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis underneath, and Docker and Linux in production. Most of this work is private because it runs real client operations, so the case studies below describe the systems without exposing them.

services.title: ERP & Operations Systems
services.desc: Procurement, production, warehouses, distribution, POS and HR, modelled on how the business actually runs. Every system comes with role-based permissions and an audit trail.

services.title: Analytics & Data Platforms
services.desc: Multi-schema data, ETL pipelines, KPI aggregation and operational dashboards that load fast and that teams trust.

services.title: SaaS & Multi-Tenant Platforms
services.desc: Tenant isolation, plans and subscriptions, configurable pipelines and automation, built to onboard the next customer without a rewrite.

services.title: Learning Platforms
services.desc: LMS products with role-focused panels for administrators, staff and learners, real-time features and scalable media storage.

services.title: APIs & Integrations
services.desc: Secure REST APIs, payment gateways, OAuth, webhooks and messaging integrations. Idempotency and validation are designed in from day one.

services.title: Infrastructure & Delivery
services.desc: Dockerised services on Linux, CI/CD pipelines with health checks and rollback, and hardened deployments that are easy to operate.

process.desc: Map the real operation: people, approvals, exceptions and the numbers that matter.
Turn it into a data model, roles and workflows before any screen is designed.
Choose boundaries, integrations and failure handling that fit the scale and the team.
Deliver in small, tested increments straight to production.
Measure, harden and extend the system as the operation grows.

projectsIntro.title: Selected work
projectsIntro.lead: Case studies are private client systems, described without code, URLs or client data. Open-source projects link to their public repositories on GitHub.

projects.name: National Waste Analytics Platform
projects.summary: Government analytics for a national waste-management program in Saudi Arabia. It consolidates operational data into KPIs and dashboards that decision-makers rely on.
highlights: Oracle multi-schema analytics across operational data sources
ETL pipelines and KPI aggregation feeding operational dashboards
Query and aggregation work that made dashboard loads 40%+ faster

projects.name: AIC Operations Suite
projects.summary: A digital ecosystem for AIC, a food-safety, quality and auditing consultancy. It connects the back office, auditors in the field and client companies on one platform.
highlights: Central admin system with granular roles and permissions
Cross-platform mobile apps for auditors and for client companies
Portals and automation that replace manual audit and reporting steps

projects.name: Factory Operations & Quality Inspections
projects.summary: A single admin platform for running daily factory operations. It covers scheduled inspections, issue tracking, review workflows and performance reporting, scoped by department and site.
highlights: Versioned inspection templates with numeric acceptance limits, scheduled by operating day, shift, time zone and exceptions without duplicate runs
Issues tied to a site and asset persist across days and block sign-off until the fix is approved
Publishable, versioned workflow editor for filling, review and corrective tasks, with deadlines and escalation
KPI dashboards for coverage, compliance, on-time rate and median/P90 handling time, with CSV export

projects.name: Food Manufacturing ERP
projects.summary: An enterprise ERP for a food manufacturer that covers the full chain, from buying raw materials to distributing finished goods and handling returns.
highlights: Procurement and production management
Multi-warehouse inventory and stock movements
Distribution and returns flows with operational controls

projects.name: Multi-School Learning Platform
projects.summary: A modular-monolith LMS for an education business that runs several virtual schools on one platform.
highlights: Five role-focused admin panels on a single modular codebase
Queued and real-time workloads with Redis, Horizon and Reverb
PostgreSQL core with S3-compatible object storage for learning media

projects.name: Gaming Community Catalog & Gifting Platform
projects.summary: A web platform for a gaming community that replaced a chat-bot workflow. It adds a searchable item catalog, a wallet, gifting and paid top-ups.
highlights: Catalog search with custom filters, price-range sliders and URL-based pagination
Discord OAuth sign-in with hashed sessions, CSRF and origin protection
Idempotent orders with duplicate prevention and safe recovery of interrupted purchases
Stripe Checkout top-ups and real-time order events over WebSockets

projects.name: Multi-Tenant B2B CRM
projects.summary: A full-stack CRM for SaaS operators. A platform owner manages tenants, plans and subscriptions, and each tenant runs its own sales pipeline from lead to closed deal.
highlights: Tenant lifecycle management: create, suspend, reactivate and configure per tenant
Configurable pipelines, custom fields and automation workflows
Role-based access control and background jobs across tenants

projects.name: Multi-Tenant POS & Inventory
projects.summary: A point-of-sale system for retail and restaurants. Company and branch data are isolated, and inventory, invoicing and reporting are built in.
highlights: Product catalog, stock tracking and low-stock alerts
Invoicing, customer loyalty, suppliers and purchase orders
Restaurant table reservations and table-based sales
Multi-language UI, granular RBAC and PDF/Excel reports

projects.name: Video Ad-Break Recommender
projects.summary: A production FastAPI service for video publishers. It analyses each video and recommends where ad breaks should go, then learns from how audiences actually retain.
highlights: Combines scene changes, transcript, silence, motion and topic signals
Optional LLM verification of proposed break points
Retention-based learning from performance snapshots
Per-channel OAuth integration with scheduled analysis jobs

projects.name: OCR & OMR Document Processing
projects.summary: Automated reading of scanned documents and forms, which replaces manual data entry with machine extraction.
highlights: OCR text extraction from scanned documents
Optical mark recognition for scanned forms
Python services ready to plug into existing workflows

projects.name: Bank & Insurer Corporate Websites
projects.summary: Corporate websites for banks, an Islamic insurer and education institutions in Jordan and Iraq.
highlights: Public web presence for regulated financial institutions
Server-rendered builds on Laravel and Yii2
Containerised builds for repeatable deployments

projects.name: JenDock
projects.summary: Self-hosted CI/CD for Docker Compose apps on your own server, compatible with Jenkinsfiles. It builds, deploys and rolls back automatically when a release is unhealthy.
highlights: Declarative Jenkinsfile subset with stages, parallel branches, when and post blocks. Unsupported syntax is rejected with a positioned message
HMAC-verified GitHub webhooks, one pinned commit per run and live step logs
Health checks with automatic rollback, plus separate Development and Production environments
GitHub-style web UI, REST API and an MCP endpoint for AI agents

projects.name: TPCT Mac
projects.summary: A macOS-style desktop for GNOME: one theme for GTK4/libadwaita, GTK3 and GNOME Shell, plus a Shell extension with a global menu bar and desktop widgets.
highlights: Light and dark themes that follow the system switch automatically
Global menu for GTK apps and for dbusmenu apps such as Chromium, Electron and JetBrains
Desktop widgets: clock, weather, calendar, world clock, now playing, photos and battery
One-step installer that also themes the dock, Qt apps and Firefox

projects.name: Idempotent Exercise Session Ingest
projects.summary: A Firebase Functions endpoint that ingests exercise-session events correctly under retries, duplicates and out-of-order delivery.
highlights: Idempotency keys prevent duplicate events on retries
Out-of-order events still produce correct session aggregates
Atomic event upsert and aggregation in Firestore transactions
Payload validation plus logging and metrics for production monitoring

projects.name: Explainable 28-Day Consistency Score
projects.summary: A transparent 0–100 score for exercise consistency over the last 28 days. It is designed to be easy to explain and easy to render on mobile.
highlights: Frequency (0–50), regularity (0–30) and recency (0–20) components
Deterministic, non-medical scoring that users can understand
Firestore query layer with a typed scoring module

projects.name: Order & Payment API
projects.summary: A RESTful Laravel API for users, products, orders and payments, secured with JWT and returning a consistent JSON envelope.
highlights: JWT authentication on every endpoint except registration and login
Order and payment resources with a uniform data/meta response format
Documented endpoints with request and response examples

projects.name: Social Media Scheduler
projects.summary: A Laravel application for scheduling, publishing and tracking posts across multiple social platforms.
highlights: Scheduled, automated publishing with platform-specific validation
Per-day rate limiting to keep the publishing schedule healthy
Dashboard analytics: posts per platform, success rates and status distribution
API access backed by a test suite for the API and models

projects.name: Egyptian National ID Validator API
projects.summary: A Django REST Framework API that validates Egyptian national ID numbers and extracts the details encoded in them.
highlights: Extracts birth date, age, gender and governorate of registration
API-key authentication, rate limiting and response caching
Interactive Swagger docs and an admin panel for keys and services

projects.name: Simple Compiler
projects.summary: A compiler for a small assembly-style language, written in C as the toolchain for a home-made 16-bit computer.
highlights: Register-based instruction set with MOV, ADD, SUB, MUL and DIV
Operand checks that tell registers apart from literal values
